*Scout Charisa's 10-hour spawn timer is based on <i>her</i> despawn. Upon receiving [[Scout Tools]] she despawns and different, temporary, Scout Charisa appears as part of [[Leuz's Task]]. This is when the 10 hour timer starts. The triggered Scout Charisa (holding a bag in her right hand) will despawn after 15 minutes; leaving 9 hours and 45 mins to the next spawn. Use one of these two events to set your timer for the next Scout spawn.
